chapter_seo_title: Twenty-Four War Swords Emerge: A Sword from Another World Shakes the Continent
chapter_meta_description: A mysterious flying sword from another world attacks young elites, revealing the hidden location of the legendary Twenty-Four War Swords. Xiao Chen's sacred tree resonates, and Keke brings news of the Lost Paradise seal breaking.
og_title: Twenty-Four War Swords Emerge: A Sword from Another World
og_description: A tiny, crystalline sword from another realm wounds the strongest young cultivators, uncovering the legendary Twenty-Four War Swords on the Demon Plain. Xiao Chen's sacred tree reacts, and the world trembles.
twitter_title: War Swords Emerge: Otherworld Sword Attacks
twitter_description: A terrifying flying sword from another world appears, unleashing twenty-four colossal sword beams. The sacred tree within Xiao Chen responds. Keke's news of the Lost Paradise adds to the chaos.
